 Big in Asia Singapore haze crackdown tests legal reach and regional ties
 City-state's approach highlights limits of unilateral action to tackle Indonesian fires
 KENTARO TAKEDA, FATHIYA DAHRUL and AMY CHEW October 31, 2026 06:00 JST SINGAPORE/JAKARTA/KUALA LUMPUR -- On the 23rd consecutive day of "unhealthy" air readings in Singapore, a new record, anti-pollution campaigner Low Ying Hui stood up at a town hall and blamed Indonesians for the haze shrouding the city-state.
